title: Phoenix AC Filter Size Finder
search: phoenix ac filter sizes apartments homes
problem: People forget HVAC filter dimensions, then buy the wrong 3-pack during the first 110° week.
audience: Phoenix renters, homeowners, and property managers doing routine AC maintenance.
checklist: Open the return grille and photograph the printed dimensions on the old filter.
If the label is unreadable, measure length, width, and depth with a tape measure.
Write the size on the inside of the utility closet door.
Set a 45-day reminder during monsoon/dust season; 60-90 days is fine in cooler months.
Buy MERV 8-11 for most residential systems unless the HVAC tech specifies otherwise.

title: HOA Landscape Violation Photo Log
search: arizona hoa landscape violation proof photos
problem: Homeowners need boring proof that weeds, gravel, and tree trimming were handled before the deadline.
audience: Arizona homeowners responding to HOA landscape notices.
checklist: Take one wide photo from the street before doing any work.
Photograph each cited area separately with the notice number visible nearby.
Save receipts for gravel, weed treatment, haul-away, or landscaping labor.
Take matching after photos at the same angle and time of day if possible.
Email the HOA a short note with photos attached before the cure-date deadline.

title: Garage Door Spring Symptom Checker
search: garage door spring broken symptoms phoenix
problem: A stuck garage door is urgent, but homeowners often cannot tell if the spring, opener, or track failed.
audience: Suburban homeowners comparing repair calls before booking service.
checklist: Do not pull hard on the opener if the door feels unusually heavy.
Look above the door for a visible gap in the torsion spring coil.
Check whether cables are loose or hanging near the track.
Listen for opener motor noise with no door movement, then stop testing.
Ask repair companies for spring-cycle rating, warranty, and same-day availability.

title: Arizona Pool Filter Cleaning Log
search: how often clean pool filter arizona dust storm
problem: Dust storms and summer use make pool filters clog faster than generic national advice suggests.
audience: Arizona pool owners deciding whether to DIY or hire pool service.
checklist: Record clean-filter PSI after a full backwash or cartridge cleaning.
Clean again when pressure rises 8-10 PSI over the baseline.
After a dust storm, skim first, then check PSI before running the pump longer.
Inspect cartridges for cracked bands, flattened pleats, or brittle end caps.
Keep a dated note of cleanings so pool techs can spot recurring problems.

title: Moving Box Count Estimator
search: how many moving boxes for two bedroom apartment
problem: People underestimate box count and end up buying expensive emergency boxes the night before moving.
audience: Renters planning a local move and comparing mover quotes.
checklist: Count closets first; they usually drive the surprise box total.
Use small boxes for books, dishes, tools, and pantry cans.
Use medium boxes for most household goods; avoid overfilling large boxes.
Reserve wardrobe boxes for hanging clothes only if wrinkle-free delivery matters.
Buy tape, labels, and a marker pack before packing day starts.

title: Water Heater Age Lookup Checklist
search: water heater serial number age lookup
problem: Homeowners see a rusty tank and need to know whether it is near end-of-life before it leaks.
audience: Homeowners, landlords, and buyers reviewing inspection notes.
checklist: Photograph the model and serial-number sticker before searching online.
Find the manufacturer date code; brand formats differ.
Check for water in the drain pan, rust trails, or damp flooring nearby.
Ask for replacement quotes before failure if the tank is 10+ years old.
Note whether the unit is gas, electric, tankless, garage, closet, or attic mounted.

title: Short-Term Rental Restock List
search: airbnb restock checklist toiletries towels kitchen
problem: Hosts lose reviews over boring missing items: batteries, paper towels, coffee filters, and trash bags.
audience: Small short-term rental hosts and cleaners doing same-day turnovers.
checklist: Create minimum par levels for paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, and soap.
Keep batteries for remotes, keypad locks, smoke detectors, and fans.
Photograph supply closets after every turnover for accountability.
Separate guest-facing extras from cleaner-only backup inventory.
Review restock receipts monthly to catch waste or underpricing.
